name: Llamas Unleashed
summary: Chaotic herd-building card game where players collect llamas, alpacas, goats and rams while sabotaging rivals to win.
rules_text: Each player starts with a Baby Animal in their Field and 5 cards. The deck contains Instant, Upgrade, Downgrade, Magic, and Animal cards. On your turn: 1) resolve any beginning-of-turn effects in your Field, 2) Draw 1, 3) Action - play one Upgrade, Downgrade, Magic, or Animal from hand to any Field or Draw 1 more, 4) discard to 7. Upgrades/Downgrades/Animals only have effect in a Field. Instant cards can be played anytime in response to another card, forming a chain that must fully resolve. Herd Bonus: if you start turn with 3+ of same species (Llama/Alpaca/Goat/Ram) you gain its bonus from Reference card. First player to have 7 Animals in their Field (5-6 with fewer players) when no chain is active wins.
rating_reason: Unstable Unicorns-style card game, hidden hands, strategic.
